angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 299,151 km at 57.85 pc = 0.07 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 17.2861 +/- 0.0165 mas (same row, RUWE 1.16): 57.85 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.43 +/- 0.013 solar radii from Ikuta et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-654.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025PASJ...77.1101I/abstract): 299,151 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.419 +/- 0.009 solar masses from Ikuta et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-654.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025PASJ...77.1101I/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3521 +/- 33 K from Ikuta et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-654.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025PASJ...77.1101I/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Ikuta et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-654.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025PASJ...77.1101I/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-654.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.793, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-654 (pscomppars): spectral type M2 V, from Ikuta et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025PASJ...77.1101I/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-654 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.12 dex, from Ikuta et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025PASJ...77.1101I/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-654 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.60906, from Ikuta et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025PASJ...77.1101I/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-654 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3 km/s, from Ikuta et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025PASJ...77.1101I/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
